shots.pre: Medium shot at the same bakery counter from the street side: the baker comes round the counter and points at someone off to the right.
shots.post: Round loaves lie on the counter behind him.
shots.layout: The camera stands in the street in front of the counter; the baker is in the middle, the counter with loaves behind him, the balconies above.

shots.pre: Close-up insert on the bakery counter: a hand puts a coin next to a round loaf.
shots.post: The wood of the counter and the loaves are sharp, the street behind is blurred.
shots.layout: The camera looks at the counter top from the street side, close; only the hand, the coin and the loaves are in the picture.

shots.pre: Wide shot of the same street from the back of the bakery: the crowd of Roman citizens in togas laughs while the legionary salutes the baker.
shots.post: The crowd stands in the street between the counter and the fountain.
shots.layout: The camera stands inside the bakery behind the counter and looks out into the street; the fountain is on the right of the picture, the Colosseum far down the street.

shots.pre: Medium shot over the legionary's shoulder at the same counter: the baker smiles and hands him a loaf.
shots.post: The baker holds the loaf out across the counter.
shots.layout: The camera stands behind the legionary's left shoulder; the baker faces the camera behind the counter; the street is behind the camera.
shots.change: Cut to a medium shot over the legionary's shoulder: the baker hands him a loaf.
